svg.title: deploy.yml, from a manual run to ECS
svg.desc: deploy.yml, from a manual run to ECS. 11 components in 5 groups. Connections: Developer to Test job; Test job to Demo job; Test job to OIDC login (DEPLOY_ENABLED); OIDC login to docker build; docker build to Render task def; Render task def to ECS deploy; ECS deploy to Smoke test; OIDC login to IAM deploy role; docker build to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (push); ECS deploy to Amazon Elastic Container Service; Amazon Elastic Container Registry to Amazon Elastic Container Service (pull); Smoke test to Amazon Elastic Container Service (GET /health).

text.tspan: DEPLOY.YML, FROM A MANUAL RUN TO ECS
The tests always run. Everything after them waits for DEPLOY_ENABLED=true and the AWS setup in aws/README.md
AWS CLOUD (SET UP BY HAND, SEE AWS/)
